name: Which Place Looks Greener? Greenery Perception (SPECS, 5 cities)
description:
Faithful replication of the greenery branch of the SPECS survey with the paper's own 400 street view images (SPECS dataset on Hugging Face, matiasqr/specs, CC BY-SA 4.0; 80 images each from Abuja, Amsterdam, Santiago, Singapore and San Francisco, originally from the NUS Global Streetscapes dataset). Quintana et al. (2026, Landscape and Urban Planning 271:105618) compared objective greenery (Green View Index and the spatial arrangement of vegetation in each image) with perceived greenery from pairwise "Which place looks greener?" votes by 1,000 participants from five countries (200 each), who also gave detailed demographics and a Big Five personality inventory. Perceived and measured greenery correlated consistently across geographies; demographics and personality mattered little, while where people live mattered most; and the spatial arrangement of greenery in view, rather than its proximity, shaped perception.

What participants do: after consent, they answer the SPECS onboarding: gender, age group, nationality, country and city of residence, years in the country, household income, household size, education, ethnicity and the 10 Big Five items (5-point agreement). Then 5 pairs of street views from the five cities: which place looks greener, or "Both are the same to me".

Analysis as in the paper: greenery perception score per image from pairwise votes, computed by the participant's country; correlate with Green View Index from panoptic segmentation and with greenery spatial entropy; compare groups by demographics and personality.

Differences from the original study: (1) the SPECS survey asked 5 pairs for each of 10 perceptions (50 pairs); this template keeps only the 5 greenery pairs (the full survey is the separate SPECS template); (2) images are resized to 1024 × 768. The earlier version of this template pointed to a Hugging Face dataset without bundled images.
author: Quintana, Liu, Torkko, Gu, Liang, Hou, Ito, Zhu, Abdelrahman, Toivonen, Lu & Biljecki
